Property Overview

2.027 acres (88,296 SF) of commercial highway land at the signalized corner of 1400 North and Main Street in Layton, Utah — back on the market and available. Offered at $2,550,000 with C-H zoning and approximately 22,000 vehicles per day. The site is an improved corner with curb, gutter, and sidewalk — development-ready for a retail pad, drive-through, or mixed commercial use.

Positioned near Layton Hills Mall, Hill Air Force Base, Kohl's, Jiffy Lube, and 7-Eleven, with 197,936 residents and a median household income of $107,279 within 5 miles. A prior transaction did not close, so this hard-corner Main Street parcel is once again available — and the seller is ready to move. Bring your pad-site and drive-through users.
